department: Computer Science (Courant Institute; newly merged PhD with NYU Tandon)

deadline.value: The page gives December 12 with no year, so it is not used as a Fall 2027 date.

gre_subject.value: Computer science has no GRE subject test; the page's GRE statement covers GRE scores generally.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by a faculty committee on the statement of purpose and research letters, not by a named supervisor first.
supervisor.quote: Admission decisions are made by a faculty committee.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students in good standing receive financial support: a nine-month stipend, tuition and fees, and health insurance.
funding.quote: All full-time Computer Science Ph.D. students in good standing receive financial support, including a nine-month stipend during the academic year, payment of tuition and fees, and health insurance.

also.quote: Basically, yes, but let's be more precise.

entry_route.value: The unified PhD takes applicants with an undergraduate degree or a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: We seek creative, articulate students with undergraduate and master's degrees from top universities worldwide.

gre_general.value: The Courant page says GRE scores are not expected or required; the older Tandon CS FAQ says they are optional. Both mean no GRE is needed.
gre_general.quote: Applicants are not expected or required to submit GRE scores.

also.quote: Scores for the GRE General Score are optional for all applicants.

english_waiver.value: A bachelor's or master's taught in English needs no TOEFL or IELTS; other applicants need one.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL or IELTS scores, unless the student's native language is English or they completed (or will complete) a baccalaureate or master's degree at an institution where the language of instruction is English.

toefl_min.value: The page requires TOEFL or IELTS but gives no minimum score.

ielts_min.value: The page requires TOEFL or IELTS but gives no minimum score.

notes: Applications go through the GSAS portal (GSAS fee not on fetched pages). The Tandon merged-PhD page and the older Tandon CS FAQ are cited for the conflicts. The Courant page's funding line is the one used; the Tandon FAQ says support is typical rather than guaranteed (flagged).
